titulo: Verbs with prepositions 2: darauf, daran, worauf, woran: Da(r)- + preposition

aula.titulo: Verbs with prepositions 2: darauf, daran, worauf, woran
aula.objetivo: Use the pronominal adverbs with «da(r)-» (darauf, daran, davon…) to refer back to things and situations, the questions with «wo(r)-» (worauf, woran…), and the anticipating structure «darauf, dass …» / «darauf, … zu …».

blocos.titulo: The pronominal adverb with da(r)-, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: if the verb takes a preposition and the object is a THING or a SITUATION that has already been mentioned, German replaces «preposition + noun» with «DA(R)- + preposition»: «Ich warte auf den Bus» → «Ich warte DARAUF.» (English does something similar with "for it", "about that".) STEP 2: form: «da-» + a preposition that starts with a consonant (damit, davon, dafür, dazu, danach) and «DAR-» + a preposition that starts with a vowel (darauf, daran, darüber, darum, darin). STEP 3: it is ONLY for things and situations. For PEOPLE, use the preposition + pronoun: «Ich warte auf ihn» (and not «darauf»). STEP 4: the pronominal adverb can come at the beginning of the sentence for emphasis: «Darauf freue ich mich.» STEP 5: remember: «damit» is also a conjunction (so that); here it is an adverb («with that»).

tabela.complete: Ich beschäftige mich mit dem Problem.

erros.certo: Ich denke an die Reise. / Ich denke daran.
erros.motivo: Either the noun or the pronominal adverb.

blocos.enunciado: Refer back to 6 things out loud with «da(r)-»: «Ich warte auf den Bus → Ich warte darauf.»
